verdicts.why: The screenshot does show his military certificate pinned on Spider-Man's board, so this is a past group the screen shows, keyed to his first title, with no departure. But the certificate reads 'Exercito do Delvadia ... Certificacion de Servicio Militar' (the Army of Delvadia), and 'Delvadian Armed Forces' is only the MCU wiki's label. The dataset names armies like 'U.S. Army' and 'British Army', and Marvel Database also uses 'Delvadian Army'.

The owner already settled this in mockup-data/audit2/morning_calls.json: 'The Plotter (1967): add The Enforcers from the start', because the person who runs a crew is in it. Marvel Database lists his affiliation as the Enforcers: in episode 14B he hires Ox and Cowboy and directs them to steal the missile blueprint.

The screen tells that he rules Latveria. In Secret Wars Chapter I, the Beyonder says Doom is so hated by the people of Latveria that they hired assassins, and in Chapter III he turns Doc Ock's domain into 'New Latveria'. X-Men '97 S1 credits him as the Latverian OZT Member. A nation its ruler leads counts as a group, as Polemachus and Ancient Egypt already do in the dataset. Story order, Latveria then OZT, is right.

S3 episode 11 transcript: Malick tells Coulson 'It'll cost me millions... I'll have to shut down a few offices', then a news report says 'Gothite Industry closed 10 offices today... Gideon Malick could not be reached for comment.' He owns and runs the company, so it is not a minor one-off job. Putting it before the S3 HYDRA stage leaves the existing stages unchanged.

In the Blade: Trinity script, Vance drugs Blade after arranging his transfer, and Blade says 'You're one of them. A familiar.' Vance answers 'Going on five years now. It's the endgame, Blade.' That is service to the Talos vampires, under the dataset's existing name The House of Talos (used for Vreede). Drake later kills him because 'he'd outlived his purpose', and death is not a departure.

In S1, Blake is only campaign staff, then a City Hall aide, then Deputy Mayor (episode 8), which is Fisk's administration. Nothing has him in the criminal side before that, or leaving it and rejoining. S2 pulls him in: Cashman makes him bury Savva's body (Wikipedia has this in episode 5, not 4; the stage is keyed to the season either way) and feed BB false information, and he holds BB for Cashman. In episode 7 he turns and lets her escape, and Cashman kills him, so Independent at S2 stands.
